fields.label: Statement
fields.value: In contests settled by display, where the animal willing to persist longer wins and costs grow with time, the stable strategy is to choose a persistence time at random from an exponential distribution whose mean equals the resource value.

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: with cost linear in time at unit rate and resource value V, the ESS persistence time has density p(x) = \frac{1}{V} e^{-x/V}

fields.value: Record contest durations in a display-based contest system and test for an exponential distribution, with the mean scaling with experimentally varied resource value.
